Extracts content with aggressive preprocessing, excluding nav, sidebar, footer

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine_config = { 'content' => { 'preprocessing_preset' => 'aggressive' }, 'respect_robots_txt' => false }
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config.to_json)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.scrape(engine, url)
puts result.inspect
```
